source_claims_used: MIPRO/MIPROv2 optimizes free-form instructions and few-shot demonstrations for language-model programs.
The paper describes program- and data-aware instruction proposal, stochastic minibatch evaluation, a surrogate model, and meta-optimization of proposal construction.
Current DSPy documentation says MIPROv2 jointly optimizes instructions and demonstrations, or instructions alone, and uses Bayesian Optimization to choose combinations.

chat_native_reduction.mode: instruction-only abstraction; no demonstration import is required for this selected leaf
chat_native_reduction.proposal: program/data-aware proposal may generate a bounded role-local assignment-policy instruction but is UNEVALUATED and cannot alter frozen control, CLEAN input, safety/authority, stable IDs, selector seal or readback-before-credit
chat_native_reduction.surrogate: Bayesian/surrogate utility is exploration-only NONFACTUAL; it cannot create terminal evidence, completion, archive utility or credit
chat_native_reduction.evaluation: only predeclared mechanical checks plus independently read-back terminal evidence create factual utility
chat_native_reduction.meta_optimization: changes to proposal heuristics remain inside the selected leaf and cannot rewrite the immutable envelope or certify themselves
chat_native_reduction.recovery: pending switch and sealed selector decision precede proposal, surrogate search or reselection
